g.text: Preserved observation geometry, better factual prediction,

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #40515c

g.text: 2000 updates; fixed orthogonal map; same model initialization, data and planner.
Bars: two-seed means. Dots: individual training seeds. 95% intervals: paired case bootstrap, conditional on these seeds.
Fresh cases are different goal pairs from the same validation pool. This is a mechanism control, not a new algorithm.
